description: Run a periodic (scheduled) rule once now, outside its schedule. It can notify like a scheduled run (test-mode rules alert only). The run appears in securenow_alert_rule_runs within seconds with trigger "manual". Instant rules have nothing to run (they check every request); use securenow_alert_rule_explain instead. Write action; requires confirmation.

confirm.description: Required for write actions. Must be true.

id.description: Alert rule id (an active periodic rule).

reason.description: Short human-readable reason for the write action.

name: securenow_alert_rule_run_now
title: Run Alert Rule Now
